integrity: All ranks are proved over the complex numbers using a self-contained unit-circle rank lemma and exact congruences; the included finite exact-cyclotomic checks corroborate, but do not establish, the infinite family. No external scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Three-by-three minors only; prime-power cyclic moduli; per-rank census is an explicit finite valuation sum, not a factorized polynomial. General equivalence to older unpublished or unindexed rank-census calculations remains a risk.
title: Exact valuation-profile rank census for three-by-three prime-power Fourier minors
